item.title: I-45 LANES HAVE REOPENED IN WILLIS
item.description: Interstate 45 N near Calvary Road. The northbound main lanes are shut down for a major accident. Multiple agencies are currently on scene. Please avoid the area and watch for first responders! 317PM-LANES NOW OPEN

item.title: Fire Traffic Alert: Kingscote Way – The Woodlands – Residential Fire
item.description: 3:55 p.m. Firefighters are responding to a detached garage fire reported at 26 Kingscote Way, off of Sterling Ridge.
